diagnosed_change_only.unchanged: already accepted staged assets, semantic version, target triple, official bytes and hashes, safe archive membership, extraction logic, Hindsight source and lock identities, resource ceilings, and scientific roles

materializers.role: recovery2 materializer with target-qualified version assertion

acceptance: The already staged archive and checksum independently match frozen bytes, hashes, and sidecar content.
The archive still contains exactly the safe directory, uv, and uvx members.
The fresh target contains exactly uv and uvx with retained sizes and hashes.
The recovery2 evidence root retains the archive and sidecar and is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED without TERMINAL_REJECTED.
failure: Any staged identity mismatch, collision, archive-member change, extraction error, or exact output mismatch seals the fresh recovery2 root as TERMINAL_REJECTED and preserves all artifacts.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit recovery2, then use this exact binary to export the official Hindsight uv.lock with --frozen and no dependency installation.
prohibited_actions: editing or deleting v1 or recovery1 rejected roots and targets
network access or retransferring the accepted staged assets
changing any release or Hindsight identity beyond the exact version-output assertion
installing dependencies, downloading models, or starting pg0/service/lifecycle/numerical work
populating any comparison-table numeric cell from recovery2
